blurb: Atma Yoga offers yoga classes in studio and online, as well as massages and ayurvedic treatments. Guests can choose from various class packages and subscriptions with options for unlimited monthly access. The studio also provides guidance on yoga practice and ayurvedic health through free resources and personalized consultations.
